summary.text: Fate Reforged takes place on Tarkir and follows the planeswalker Sarkhan Vol, who is led by Ugin's whispers and travels 1,280 years back in time to change the moment that sealed Tarkir's fate.
There he meets Yasova Dragonclaw and learns that Nicol Bolas, who has tracked Ugin to Tarkir, means to kill him, and Sarkhan wraps the mortally wounded Ugin in a hedron cocoon, rewriting history.
In the new timeline the dragon tempests grow, and in the Khanfall dragons overtake the clans as five dragonlords and their broods rise to dominate the humanoid races.
